- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and my own Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
